The '''Palace of Gala''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]]. The members of the [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]] resided there. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the palace while on a [[mission to Gala]].<ref name="JA">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]''</ref>
